sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Casterwill's youngest daughter fought alongside her family in the great war against the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

She has her siblings were teleported by Umbra to the Spiral Mark, where she watched Lord Casterwill seal the Mark using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]

Some time after the death of Lord Casterwill, on the longest night of the year, she and her siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him from using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]

She eventually laid the Ring of Phoenix to rest in the Phoenix Volcano where it was eventually recovered by Sophie Casterwill. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

full_text:
The younger daughter of Casterwill was one of Lord Casterwill's children and the previous Seeker bonded to Phoenix, the Legendary Titan of Rebirth.

== History ==
Casterwill's youngest daughter fought alongside her family in the great war against the Nullifiers. [Knight of the Willblade]

She has her siblings were teleported by Umbra to the Spiral Mark, where she watched Lord Casterwill seal the Mark using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]

Some time after the death of Lord Casterwill, on the longest night of the year, she and her siblings fought the Betrayer at the Spiral Mark, stopping him from using Void to call back the Nullifiers. [Chasing Void]

She eventually laid the Ring of Phoenix to rest in the Phoenix Volcano where it was eventually recovered by Sophie Casterwill. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

==Abilities==
Not much in known on the younger daughter's abilities, but she was a courageous Seeker who fought boldly against the Betrayer and the Nullifiers.
===Bonded Titans===
*Phoenix
